Do not let the refusal extra call (engine.py _call_refusal_provider) or any narration/recovery/JSON-mode/malformed-recovery send move to the new counter: only name-matching requests from item_facts.py do. Prefer an explicit keyword/argument or small Protocol over getattr/isinstance. Do NOT change engine retry behaviour or the sanitized rejection note.
